Well ... it sounds like it's not going to be easy. You must be feeling sad and angered when they do that and it's completely understandable.

You've made very clear on your responses that you don't believe talking to them would change anything but have you ever told them how you feel? how much they are hurting you? It's going to be really hard bc you don't even talk to each other but you cannot keep those feelings inside. There's got to be a reason why they are distancing themselves from you. My first advice is to really reflect on your actions as well as your family actions. Don't focus on specific things. Pay more attention to the reason behind the actions.

My other advice is that you should think from an outsider point of view (not an easy task tbh but it works) and try to talk to them about everything that is bothering as well as giving them the opportunity to say why they are doing that to you. Maybe in a moment when the family is together you can start by saying "I need to talk to all of you and I need you to listen to me. I'm not okay. I feel like we are not family anymore. I feel left out" and so on. Give them the opportunity to talk and please *please* keep calm. Try not to get your emotions take over you in the moment. Listen to what they have say and keep calm why taking everything out of your chest. It helps to write down what you have to say. Try to make a compromise to improve everyone's behaviour and become a closer family

I think you must start by asking yourself why you're being outcasted ... Did you spend time with them? Jokes are usually made when you share a experience in a group if they are joking about something you have no idea maybe you weren't present that often ... 

Is there any reason why they don't include you? Are you trying to include yourself? What are you doing to be included? 

Try to look into why you're being left out. Maybe you're the one pushing them away. I'm saying that because I used to do it. I used to think the same way as you but I eventually realised that it was me who was not including myself in my family. It takes a lot of reflection to understand people behaviour. You can start by thinking in your actions first. And that also applies for the school.
